description: Defines classes and interfaces for F1-U split gateway and GTP-U tunnel adapters in a 5G network context, including adapters for GTP-U PDUs, NR-U SDUs, and session management for DU and CU-UP bearers.

classes.name: gtpu_tx_udp_gw_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for transmitting GTP-U PDUs over UDP, passing PDUs to the IO gateway.

classes.name: gtpu_rx_f1u_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for receiving NR-U SDUs (DL and UL messages) from GTP-U.

classes.name: network_gateway_data_gtpu_demux_adapter
classes.description: Adapter connecting Network Gateway data to GTP-U demux.

classes.name: f1u_split_gateway_du_bearer
classes.description: Represents a bearer at the CU F1-U gateway, managing GTP-U tunnels and SDU handling.

classes.name: f1u_split_connector
classes.description: Connects DU and CU-UP F1-U bearers, managing bearer creation/removal and session mapping.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Handles new PDU for GTP-U transmission.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the adapter to a handler.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the adapter from its handler.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles new SDU (NR-U message) from GTP-U.

methods.name: get_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the bind address for the F1-U gateway.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the bearer and releases resources.

methods.name: get_tunnel_rx_interface
methods.description: Returns the receive interface of the GTP-U tunnel.

methods.name: create_du_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new DU bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: remove_du_bearer
methods.description: Removes a DU bearer based on transport layer info.

methods.name: get_du_bind_address
methods.description: Retrieves the bind address for a specific gNB DU ID.
